أقترع (form VIII)
# أَقْتَرِعُ (ʔaqtariʕu) /ʔaq.ta.ri.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# أُقْتَرَعُ (ʔuqtaraʕu) /ʔuq.ta.ra.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# أَقْتَرِعَ (ʔaqtariʕa) /ʔaq.ta.ri.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# أُقْتَرَعَ (ʔuqtaraʕa) /ʔuq.ta.ra
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
